resolution_model.cascade_trigger_eligibility: Only paid Grinning Ignus casts from hand during own turn with commander controlled and opponent aggregate turn loss >=3; printed MV3 irrespective of reductions. Other possible commander-granted cascade triggers from unrelated hand spells are deliberately omitted and flagged.
resolution_model.birgi: If front face already controlled, one red added after cast-trigger resolution, before cascade trigger resolution; additional eligible free cast also generates Birgi red if controlled; casting Birgi itself does not trigger its own ability.
resolution_model.first_hit: physically exile cards until first nonland MV < 3, choose optional cast only for source-verified supported subset with legal fixed targets, physically return all uncast exiles to library bottom in seeded shuffled order

supported_effects.Dark Ritual: Add BBB at resolution; spell goes to graveyard
supported_effects.Rite of Flame: Add RR plus R per *other* Rite of Flame already in a graveyard; card resolves then moves to graveyard
supported_effects.Boltwave: 3 to each of 3 opponents (aggregate 9), no pilot damage
supported_effects.Flame Rift: 4 to each of 3 opponents (aggregate 12), 4 pilot damage, pilot tracked only for this effect
supported_effects.Ancestral Vision: target self, draw up to three cards from current physical library into physical hand
supported_effects.Sol Ring: artifact enters; once in its entry turn, tap to add CC into shared main-phase pool (tracked tapped)
supported_effects.Lotus Petal: artifact enters; immediately tap and sacrifice for R, enters graveyard; fixed red-choice policy
supported_effects.Profane Tutor: Search actual remaining library for highest-priority target from fixed list, move card to hand, seeded shuffle; if no candidate available select lexical first eligible nonland as fallback
supported_effects.Demonic Tutor: Same actual physical library search and move to hand; no imagined copy
supported_effects.Vampiric Tutor: Search actual library, seeded shuffle, place target card on TOP; pilot loses 2 (tracked)
supported_effects.Imperial Seal: Same top-deck search and pilot 2 life loss (tracked); fixed sorcery timing bypassed only because cascade lets its sorcery spell be cast during cascade resolution
supported_effects.Gamble: Search library, put physical target in hand, seeded shuffle, random one physical card discarded (including possibly tutored card) to graveyard; never assume tutored card survives

tutor_priority: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
unsupported_or_declined: Mystical Tutor (instant/sorcery search with card text timing)
resolution_model.decline_policy: If first eligible hit is unsupported or lacks permitted targets, do not cast, put it and other exiles to bottom. Cascade cannot skip this hit to find a later preferred spell.
resolution_model.token_or_other_trigger_effects: NOT modeled: Storm-Kiln Artist, The Lost and the Damned, Prosper, Keeper of Secrets, Passionate Archaeologist or any alternate hand-cast cascade (must disclose)

adversarial_cases: Dark Ritual adds exactly 3 black into same shared main-phase pool; no source invented
Rite of Flame adds exactly 2 red with no other Rite in graveyard, even if resolving original later moves to graveyard
Sol Ring enters battlefield and taps once for 2 colorless; its mana is not colored and is not reactivated in same turn
Lotus Petal single red choice costs its physical artifact; moves to graveyard once
Ancestral Vision draws three from real mutable library; next cascade encounters shifted top and cards are not duplicated
Profane Tutor physically searches and removes target to hand then reshuffles physical residual deck; target is not cast automatically
Vampiric/Imperial top-deck tutor changes next cascade outcome and causes 2 pilot life loss; not opponent threshold
Gamble discards exactly one randomly chosen physical card including possible tutored piece; zero guaranteed tutor retention
Ignus MV3 cascade no duplicate grant to spell cast from exile and no automatic self-cascade by cast hit
Rule of Law/Drannith remain isolated conditional exclusions (cannot treat as a noninteractive sampled frequency)
Any unsupported eligible hit is put back on library bottom, not magically resolved
At most five paid recasts per main, all sharing the single physically mutated deck, mana pool, land taps, hand and zone inventories
Rakdos, Familiar and Rite incumbent opportunity costs are not scored zero
